build_register_plugin_request: build a pydantic RegisterPluginRequest with name, git source, and optional version for marketplace plugin registration
create_marketplace_response: create a MarketplaceResponse with owner info and list of MarketplacePluginEntry objects for Claude Code CLI consumption
create_plugin_author: create a PluginAuthor with name and optional email for plugin metadata
test_plugin_response: test the PluginResponse model with id, name, version, description, source, and enabled fields
summarize_list_plugins_response: summarize the ListPluginsResponse containing a list of PluginListItem objects and total count
